title: Reverse Linked List
statement:
Given the `head` of a singly linked list, reverse the list and return its new head.

A node is `ListNode { val int  next ListNode? }` (an empty list is `null`).

**Example**

```
1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4 -> 5   =>   5 -> 4 -> 3 -> 2 -> 1
```

tests.call: ReverseList(ListNode { val: 1, next: ListNode { val: 2, next: ListNode { val: 3, next: null } } })
tests.expected: ListNode { val: 3, next: ListNode { val: 2, next: ListNode { val: 1, next: null } } }

tests.call: ReverseList(ListNode { val: 1, next: ListNode { val: 2, next: null } })
tests.expected: ListNode { val: 2, next: ListNode { val: 1, next: null } }
